doc.title: Deployment Gate Decision: Meridian Release Train

footing_cases.author: Xena ExpertGH
footing_cases.when: Editorial text summarizing decisions and framing the document

segments.exact:
Every Meridian deployment now requires a signed release
manifest before it ships. We saw two unsigned artifacts reach staging
last quarter and that is the whole reason for the gate.

circumstance.context: Deployment Gate Decision: Meridian Release Train

- **Scope**: applies to staging and production
